rich_text.text: A residence permit lets you:
Source (in Russian):
https://journal.tinkoff.ru/news/vnzh-v-gruzii
Stay in Georgia without having to leave the country every year.
Apply for Schengen and other visas at foreign consulates in Georgia. Ordinary tourists usually can't do this and have to apply in Russia.
Invite relatives who need a visa to enter, and later arrange residence permits for them.
Later obtain permanent residence in Georgia and, under certain conditions, citizenship.
Get other benefits, such as full access to the country's online public services or
the ability to issue powers of attorney remotely through Georgian notaries
in Georgian and Russian. Such a power of attorney is directly valid in Russia.
Residence permit holders sometimes get discounts on tickets to national parks and museums. For example,
a ticket to Martvili Canyon
costs GEL 17.25⁣ (555 ₽) for tourists and GEL 10.35⁣ (333 ₽) for foreigners with a Georgian residence permit and Georgian citizens. The same prices apply to
Kinchkha Waterfall.
The
Batumi Botanical Garden
website says a regular ticket costs GEL 20⁣ (644 ₽), and for permanent residents GEL 10⁣ (322 ₽).
Perks
You can register at Aversi pharmacies and show your binadroba on each visit to get discounts.
This page will be updated

title: What a residence permit gives you
